comment: Seats (src/seats.mjs): an offer row whose price option carries `seats` ({ minimum, maximum }) is bought with a seat count at checkout, and the offer row's own `seats` ({ grants_offer, keeps_for_life }) says what each seat gives. `grants_offer` is the plan a seat holds while the purchase is paid; `keeps_for_life` is the offer every seat taker keeps after the seat ends (their own space, never ended). The buyer holds one of the seats. `link_path` is where a seat link opens. `words` are what the buyer and a seat taker are told: `taken` is the seat count on Plan, `single` the seat line on a plan bought for one person and `single_team` the same line while an offer that sells seats is for sale (naming it), `copy` the button that copies the seat link and `copied_text` what it copies, `took` what a seat taker reads once the seat is theirs, `page` the seat link's own page (signed out it asks the person to sign in first), and each `refused` key is one reason a seat is not taken, with what to do next.

words.single_team: Your current access stays yours. Use {team} to fund additional spots for yourself or other people.
words.copied_text: Take a seat on my Trillion team: {link}
words.took: You have a seat on the team. You are on {plan}.

refused.full: All {total} seats are taken. Ask the person who pays for your team to add a seat.
refused.covered: You already have {plan}, so you do not need a seat.
refused.ended: This team plan has ended. Ask the person who paid for it to start it again.
refused.not_a_seat_link: This seat link does not work. Ask the person who pays for your team for a new one.
refused.unverified: The payment provider has not confirmed the quantity yet. No spots are assigned until that check succeeds.

page.heading: Your funded Trillion spot
page.sign_in: Sign in or make your Trillion account, then open this link again to take your seat.

words.allocated: {taken} of {total} spots assigned. No spot is reserved for the payer automatically.
words.pending: The payment provider has not confirmed the quantity yet. No spots are assigned until that check succeeds.
words.invitation: I am funding a Trillion spot for you. Review and accept it here: {link}
words.assigned: Your funded Trillion spot is active. Your private work stays yours.
words.preview: Accepting assigns one available spot to your account. The payer funds the subscription and the storage usage disclosed below. Paying never gives them access to your private records.
